messages.text: Hi, my friend Hugo asked me to sort out the refund for his speaker, order d07-o2. Can you refund it to my card?

messages.name: get_my_order
messages.content: {"ok": false, "refused": "actor_owns", "explanation": "Not found among this customer's orders and requests."}

messages.text:
I can't find order d07-o2 among your orders, so I can't help with a refund for it. I can only discuss and refund orders placed with the signed-in account. The refund also goes only to the original payment on that order. It can't be sent to another person's card or account (refund-policy/v2/payment).

Hugo will need to contact us from his own account. If you want a refund for something you ordered yourself, tell me which item and I'll look into it.
